# Moving Average
```{r}
n <- nrow(data_mpdw)
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n)

training_ma <- data_mpdw[1:n_train, ]
testing_ma <- data_mpdw[(n_train + 1):n, ]

training_ma.ts <- ts(training_ma$`Monthly Anomaly`)
testing_ma.ts <- ts(testing_ma$`Monthly Anomaly`)
```

```{r}
library(TTR)

# 1. Membuat Fungsi Pencarian
find_optimum_sma <- function(ts_data, max_n = 12) {
  # Menyiapkan kerangka data untuk menyimpan hasil
  results <- data.frame(n = integer(), MAPE = numeric(), RMSE = numeric())
  
  # Looping untuk mencoba n dari 2 hingga batas maksimal
  for (i in 2:max_n) {
    # Proses pemulusan SMA
    sma_fit <- SMA(ts_data, n = i)
    
    # Penyesuaian lag: SMA periode ke-t adalah ramalan untuk (t+1)
    aktual <- ts_data[(i+1):length(ts_data)]
    ramalan <- sma_fit[i:(length(ts_data)-1)] 
    
    # Perhitungan Error
    error <- aktual - ramalan
    mape <- mean(abs(error / aktual), na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    rmse <- sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Menyimpan hasil setiap iterasi ke dalam tabel
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(n = i, MAPE = mape, RMSE = rmse))
  }
  
  # 2. Menampilkan Tabel Evaluasi Lengkap
  cat("--- Hasil Evaluasi Akurasi Berbagai Nilai n ---\n")
  print(results)
  
  # 3. Mengekstrak n dengan MAPE terkecil
  best_n <- results$n[which.min(results$MAPE)]
  cat("\n============================================\n")
  cat("Nilai n optimum berdasarkan MAPE terkecil adalah:", best_n, "\n")
  cat("============================================\n")
  
  return(best_n)
}

# Eksekusi Fungsi pada data Anda
# max_n adalah batas maksimal periode yang ingin Anda uji (misal: 12 periode)
n_optimum <- find_optimum_sma(training_ma.ts, max_n = 12)

# Mengaplikasikan nilai n optimum ke model akhir Anda
data.sma_optimal <- SMA(training_ma.ts, n = n_optimum)
```

## Single Moving Average
```{r}
data.sma <- SMA(training_ma.ts, n = 5)
data.sma
```

```{r}
data.ramal <- c(NA, data.sma)
data.ramal
```


```{r}
data.gab <- cbind(aktual = c(data_mpdw.ts), pemulusan = c(data.sma, rep(NA, 2065)), 
                  ramalan = c(data.ramal, rep(data.ramal[length(data.ramal)], 2064)))
data.gab
```

```{r}
ts.plot(data.gab, main = "Hasil Pemulusan dan Ramalan", ylab = "Anomaly", xlab = "Period")
points(data.gab[, "aktual"], col = "black", pch = 20)
lines(data.gab[, "pemulusan"], col = "blue", lwd = 2)
lines(data.gab[, "ramalan"], col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Aktual", "Pemulusan", "Ramalan"), 
       col = c("black", "blue", "red"), lty = c(1, 1, 2), lwd = 2)
```

# Akurasi Data Latih
```{r}
error_train_sma <- training_ma.ts - data.ramal[1:length(training_ma.ts)]

SSE_train_sma <- sum(error_train_sma^2, na.rm = TRUE)
MSE_train_sma <- mean(error_train_sma^2, na.rm = TRUE)
MAPE_train_sma <- mean(abs(error_train_sma / training_ma.ts), na.rm = TRUE) * 100

akurasi_train_sma <- matrix(c(
  SSE = SSE_train_sma,
  MSE = MSE_train_sma,
  MAPE = MAPE_train_sma
))

row.names(akurasi_train_sma) <- c("SSE", "MSE", "MAPE")
colnames(akurasi_train_sma) <- c("Nilai")
akurasi_train_sma

```
